Task: Bulk Modulus of Magnesium
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of magnesium by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for magnesium. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10

- materials_project_id: mp-153
- atom_style: atomic
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

Let's create the LAMMPS input script for elastic constant calculations. We need to write a script that will:
1. Set up the simulation
2. Use the EAM potential for Mg
3. Apply deformations and measure stresses
4. Calculate elastic constants

function.name: write_file
function.arguments:
{"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/tool_calling/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/magnesium_bulk_modulus_trial_0/elastic.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for elastic constants calculation

# Initialization
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Read structure
read_data Mg.data

# EAM potential for Mg
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Mg_Sun_JCP_2006.eam.alloy Mg

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Set up elastic calculation
variable up equal 1.0e-6
variable atomvolume equal vol/atoms

# Original box dimensions
variable len0_x equal lx
variable len0_y equal ly
variable len0_z equal lz

# Loop for elastic constants
variable i loop 6

  # Reset box to unstrained state
  clear
  read_data Mg.data
  
  pair_style eam/alloy
  pair_coeff * * /potentials/Mg_Sun_JCP_2006.eam.alloy Mg

  # Positive deformation
  if "$i == 1" then &
    "change_box all x delta 0 ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 2" then &
    "change_box all y delta 0 ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 3" then &
    "change_box all z delta 0 ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 4" then &
    "change_box all yz delta ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 5" then &
    "change_box all xz delta ${up} remap units box"
  if "$i == 6" then &
    "change_box all xy delta ${up} remap units box"

  minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000
  
  # Store stress components
  variable tmp equal pxx
  variable pxx${i} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal pyy
  variable pyy${i} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal pzz
  variable pzz${i} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal pyz
  variable pyz${i} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal pxz
  variable pxz${i} equal ${tmp}
  variable tmp equal pxy
  variable pxy${i} equal ${tmp}

next i

# Output elastic constants
print "Elastic Constants (GPa):"
print "C11 = ${pxx1}"
print "C22 = ${pyy2}"
print "C33 = ${pzz3}"
print "C23 = ${pyz4}"
print "C13 = ${pxz5}"
print "C12 = ${pxy6}"

# Calculate bulk modulus (Voigt average)
variable bulk_modulus equal (${pxx1}+${pyy2}+${pzz3}+2*(${pxy6}+${pxz5}+${pyz4}))/9
print "Bulk Modulus (GPa) = ${bulk_modulus}""}
